method: Every item individually composed as complete literal TSV text; no shared fragment bank, template, combinatorial assembly or text-generating program; helpers only copy complete text and measure it. New wording is not translated or adapted from prior corpora.
historicalReadScope: Exactly35 root and holdout-v1/v2/v3/v4 locale JSON files, only for mechanical complete-text equality checks.
conceptUnit: Underlying scenario or visual motif; group paraphrases and changes limited to colour, fabric or incidental setting. Allow multiple substantive concepts per item.
knownContext: Root has v4 results and full cases after its retirement. Existing authors retain their v4 authorship and semantic review context. No author may inspect round-3 repair or v5 screening output before seal. Builder receives only retired v4; v5 content remains blind.
releaseSequence: Finish rotated individual authorship and semantic/structural checks; write-once import; seal sources and allseven locale JSONs; send hash/counts to coordinator; wait for explicit release before round-3 repair inspection, corpus commit, active switch or evaluation.
